description: Ground truth relevance annotations for multi-candidate ranking evaluations.

relevance_scale.2: Strongly relevant: Candidate directly satisfies role domain and primary required skills.
relevance_scale.1: Partially relevant: Candidate possesses adjacent skills or a partial subset of required competencies.
relevance_scale.0: Not relevant: Candidate belongs to an unrelated engineering domain or lacks core requirements.

scenarios.description: Evaluation of 6 candidate resumes against Machine Learning Engineer requisition.

candidates.rationale: Strong match: Full 100% required skill coverage (Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, NLP, Pandas) plus Docker and spaCy.
Strong match: Complete NLP/ML required skill set (Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, NLP, Pandas) plus Deep Learning and spaCy.
Partial match: Data analyst with Python, scikit-learn, Pandas (3/5 required); lacks PyTorch and NLP.
Partial match: Backend architect with Python, Docker, and FastAPI, but lacks core ML/NLP frameworks.
Not relevant: Frontend TypeScript/React engineer with zero ML/NLP competencies.
Not relevant: Embedded systems C++/Rust developer with no ML overlap.
